newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.1 bln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.1 bln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$1.1 billion of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$600 million of five-week notes, A$200 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes.
The RBA said it would take up an additional A$200 million of the five-week notes, A$100 million of the 13-week notes and A$100 million of the 26-week notes for its own portfolio.
The tender details were announced earlier in the week than usual due to the Melbourne Cup day holiday in the Victorian state capital on Tuesday.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$1.4 billion of notes, comprising A$800 million of five-week notes, A$300 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$818 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending November 6.
